{"id":"mimid-1wgh.71","title":"SafeAAD: zero-length authenticated_data in a safe_aad group is refused (not read as an empty SafeAAD)","description":"Bead mimid-orjg. mls-rs (and any MLS stack without SafeAAD) sends a zero-length authenticated_data. In a group whose GroupContext lists safe_aad, mimi-mls's SafeAAD decode fails (EndOfStream) and the hub answers notAllowed.

mls-extensions-11 §4.9, quoted:

  "If the safe_aad component in the app_data_dictionary extension is present in the GroupContext (see Section 5), the entire authenticated_data field is framed as a SafeAAD struct such that the elements of aad_items are sorted in increasing numerical order of the component_id."

  struct { ComponentID component_id; opaque aad_item_data<V>; } SafeAADItem;
  struct { SafeAADItem aad_items<V>; } SafeAAD;

  "If safe_aad is present, but none of the "safe" AAD components have data to send in a particular message, the aad_items is a zero-length vector."

§5: "If the safe_aad component is present, even with an empty list, (in the app_data_dictionary extension) in the GroupContext, then the authenticated_data field is a SafeAAD struct as defined in Section 4.9."

Change log (-10 to -11): "unsafe AAD is no longer allowed when the safe_aad component is present in the GroupContext".

Readings:
(a) Strict: the whole authenticated_data is a SafeAAD struct; with no items it is a zero-length aad_items<V>, whose RFC 9420 §2.1.2 encoding is the one byte 0x00. A zero-length authenticated_data is not a SafeAAD encoding, so the message does not follow §4.9 and is refused.
(b) Lenient: treat zero-length authenticated_data as a SafeAAD with no items, since it carries no items either way.

Chosen (a). The text says the field "is" a SafeAAD struct, twice, and spells out the no-items case as a zero-length aad_items vector, not an absent field. The -11 change log removes the case of AAD that is not SafeAAD. Nothing in the text allows a second encoding of the empty SafeAAD, and AGENTS.md says decode strictly and reject non-canonical encodings. The text gives no explicit receiver rule (no "MUST reject"), so (b) is not forbidden in words, but it would make two encodings of one value. mimi-mls keeps refusing it in the hub (Observer) and the agent (Member); tests in crates/mimi-mls/tests/truncated_input.rs pin it. docs/didwebvh-mls-rs.md tells mls-rs applications to pass 0x00.

Flag to Mark: a WG/editor clarification is drafted in bead mimid-orjg (not posted). If the WG prefers (b), switch then.
